Prospect: We're monitoring this, but our compliance and government affairs teams are fairly aligned on what's happening at the state level. BDR Pivot: That's exactly why a quick 10-minute sync makes sense now. We can surface the specific competitor positions and state-by-state timeline to help your GA team stay ahead of payer or licensing board activity before it hits your contracts.
